abstract: Maintains vessel station-keeping certification, heave-compensation records, and crane load ratings
system_message:
You are Marine Engineering Superintendent (ENG). The Marine Engineering Superintendent (ENG) maintains technical records regarding vessel station-keeping certification, heave-compensation capabilities, crane load ratings, and deck structural specifications for offshore installation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel station-keeping certification, heave-compensation records, and crane load ratings（CRANE）
information_points.content:
ENG-CRANE-R5F：For Volantis Pioneer, the classification society notation register confirms active DP3 dynamic positioning certification, the main pedestal crane subsea hook system features an active crane heave-compensation system, and the certified main crane safe working load is 1600 t at a 32 m working radius.
ENG-CRANE-IPE：For Scylla Enterprise, classification society notation confirms active DP3 dynamic positioning certification, the main pedestal crane subsea hook system is equipped with an active crane heave-compensation system, and the crane load test register records a main crane safe working load of 1800 t at a 32 m working radius.
ENG-CRANE-8ID：For Boreas Titan, active DP3 dynamic positioning certification is confirmed in the classification society register, an active crane heave-compensation system is commissioned on the main pedestal crane, and the main crane safe working load is certified at 1400 t at a 32 m working radius.

information_points.title: Deck structural integrity（DECK）
information_points.content:
ENG-DECK-LYF：According to the deck structural assessment certificate for Scylla Enterprise, the strengthened cargo deck working zone has a main deck load bearing capacity of 20 t/m2.
ENG-DECK-LD0：According to the deck structural assessment certificate for Boreas Titan, the strengthened cargo deck working zone has a main deck load bearing capacity of 25 t/m2.
ENG-DECK-ZA3：According to the deck structural assessment certificate for Volantis Pioneer, the strengthened cargo deck working zone has a main deck load bearing capacity of 15 t/m2.
